problem:
Evaluate the mixed integral

$$
{∬}_{D}[{\int }_{0}^{\sqrt{\frac{2y}{x}}}3xyz\,dz]dA
$$

where the region $D$ in the $xy$-plane is given by

$$
D={(x,y)\,:\,1\le x\le 2,\,x-1\le y\le x+1}.
$$
worked_solution:
First, we evaluate the inner integral with respect to $z,$ treating $x$ and $y$ as constants:

$$
\begin{aligned}{∬}_{D}[{\int }_{0}^{\sqrt{\frac{2y}{x}}}3xyz\,dz]dA & ={∬}_{D}{[\frac{3}{2}xy{z}^{2}]}_{z=0}^{z=\sqrt{\frac{2y}{x}}}\,dA \\  & ={∬}_{D}\frac{3}{2}xy({(\sqrt{\frac{2y}{x}})}^{2}-0)\,dA \\  & ={∬}_{D}\frac{3}{2}xy\cdot \frac{2y}{x}\,dA \\  & ={∬}_{D}3{y}^{2}\,dA\end{aligned}
$$

Next, we evaluate the double integral:

$$
\begin{aligned}{∬}_{D}3{y}^{2}\,dA & ={\int }_{1}^{2}{\int }_{x-1}^{x+1}3{y}^{2}\,dy\,dx \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{2}[{\int }_{x-1}^{x+1}3{y}^{2}\,dy]dx \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{2}[{y}^{3}]_{y=x-1}^{y=x+1}dx \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{2}(x+1)^{3}-(x-1)^{3}\,dx \\  & ={[\frac{1}{4}(x+1)^{4}-\frac{1}{4}(x-1)^{4}]}_{x=1}^{x=2} \\  & =\frac{1}{4}(81-16)-\frac{1}{4}(1-0) \\  & =16\end{aligned}
$$
